name: Arcturus Defense Solutions Graviton Lens GL-3 'Crush Depth'
description:
A directed gravitational manipulation weapon that projects a localized gravity well at a designated point within range. The GL-3 creates a sphere of approximately 1 meter in diameter where gravitational force is amplified to 15-50G for a duration of 3 seconds. Anything within that sphere is subjected to crushing force equivalent to being buried under tons of material.

Arcturus developed the Graviton Lens as a breaching tool for reinforced structures — the gravity well collapses walls, compresses vehicles, and defeats blast doors that resist conventional explosive or thermal breaching. Its use against personnel was an afterthought that quickly became its primary application. A 50G gravity well reduces a human body to a compressed mass roughly the size of a suitcase.

The weapon requires an enormous power draw and produces a distinctive spatial distortion visible to the naked eye — a shimmering lens effect at the target point that bends light around the gravity well. The effect lasts only seconds but the results are permanent.
legality: Military restricted — classified weapons program, gravity manipulation permit
specifications:
caliber: N/A — directed gravitational effect
effective_range: 20-150 meters
rate_of_fire: 1 pulse per 20 seconds (capacitor recharge)
capacity: 8 pulses per power cell
weight: 22 kg weapon, 15 kg power pack
power_source: Dedicated gravity manipulation fusion cell
tactical_use: The Crush Depth is deployed against hardened targets that resist conventional and directed energy weapons. Its gravity well ignores armor, shielding, and cover — gravitational force acts on mass regardless of protective measures. The weapon is used for breaching blast doors, collapsing tunnel sections, and eliminating high-value targets inside armored vehicles. The 20-second recharge between pulses limits its use to deliberate engagements rather than dynamic combat.
cultural_context: The GL-3 occupies a unique position in GLMZ's weapons culture as a system that kills through a fundamental force of nature. There is no armor that stops gravity, no countermeasure that neutralizes it, and no medical intervention that reverses crushing. The weapon has generated philosophical debate about the ethics of gravitational weapons — a bullet can miss, but a gravity well affects everything within its radius equally and absolutely.
story_hooks: A gravity well was detected in a Tier 3 residential district — structural damage consistent with a GL-3 pulse, but no weapon was found and Arcturus denies any operation in the area. Either the weapon is being proliferated, or someone has independently developed gravity manipulation technology.

An operator reported that a GL-3 pulse struck a target wearing an experimental defensive system — and the gravity well inverted, repelling mass instead of attracting it. Arcturus wants that defensive system.
related_entities: Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Portable Fusion Battery PFB-2

physical_description.visual_profile: A massive, brutalist directed-energy apparatus resembling a hybrid between a particle accelerator and a mining tool. The weapon has a pronounced angular geometry with a wide, flared muzzle assembly that widens toward the front, giving it a funnel-like or lens-shaped barrel profile. Heavy and imposing, it reads as experimental military hardware rather than a refined service weapon.
physical_description.dimensions: Overall length: 127 cm. Barrel assembly width: 38 cm (flared). Depth: 22 cm. Power pack: 48 x 28 x 18 cm (tethered via armored conduit)
physical_description.weight_description: Brutally heavy and front-heavy. Requires both hands and solid stance to aim. The weight distribution pulls downward, demanding core strength and braced positioning. Not a weapon for quick-draw combat.
physical_description.primary_material: Titanium-reinforced steel frame with graphene-composite focusing array. Weapon body is steel; power pack is reinforced polymer with internal heat-sink ribbing.
physical_description.finish: Industrial matte gunmetal gray with heat-scorched sections around the muzzle. Thermal stress marks radiate outward from the barrel in concentric burn patterns. Deep scratches and scuff marks indicate field use. The focusing lens at the barrel tip is blackened quartz with hairline fractures visible under close inspection.
physical_description.color_scheme: Matte gunmetal gray primary. Charred black thermal scorch marks around muzzle and focusing lens. Accent details in brushed steel. Power cells glow faint blue-white when active.
physical_description.grip_texture: Chunky textured polymer grip with integral palm rest. Metal trigger guard with rubberized contact points. The weapon is designed to be shouldered and cradled rather than handheld like a rifle — more reminiscent of a mounted plasma cannon adapted for portable use.
distinctive_features: Flared graviton lens focusing array at barrel tip — appears as concentric rings of blackened quartz and metallic focusing coils
Three large capacitor banks visibly integrated into the frame, each marked with blue charge-status LEDs that pulse during recharge cycles
Heavy ribbed heat sinks along the sides of the barrel, glowing dull red after sustained use
A transparent polymer observation window on the left side revealing internal circuitry and graviton field stabilizers
Spatial distortion visible around the muzzle when powered — faint shimmer effect even at rest
Recessed ammunition counter display (shows remaining pulses: 0-8) mounted on the right side
Tether connection point for the external power pack, reinforced with armored coupling
Service plate stamped: 'ARCTURUS DEFENSE SOLUTIONS GL-3 CRUSH DEPTH — MILITARY RESTRICTED'
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: Arcturus Defense Solutions logo (stylized 'A' with gravitational wave motif) etched into the frame just above the trigger guard. 'CRUSH DEPTH' designation stenciled in degraded white lettering across the barrel. Military serial number and gravity manipulation license requirement stamped into the steel near the focusing lens. Ironside Armaments manufacturing date and batch code on the power pack.
physical_description.condition_typical: Battle-worn and field-maintained. The weapon shows heavy use: scorch marks around the focusing array, micro-fractures in the observation window, worn grip texture, and dents in the steel frame. Internal components are kept in functional condition despite external abuse. Capacitor banks may show minor corrosion at connection points. The blackened quartz lens is visibly damaged but still operational.

Weapon is positioned horizontally with power pack visible behind it, tethered by reinforced cable. Dramatic side-lighting from upper left casts sharp shadows, illuminating the heat-scorched thermal patterns and brushed steel accents.
